column1: # Day 3 (第三日 唯一的通路) — verified tile arrangement
# 16 tiles, each a 3x3 cell block, fixed orientation, laid out 4x4 -> a 12x12 maze.
# Tiles are numbered 1..16 in the order the elements appear in the article.
# Border deduction: only p1,p2,p16 have a full top edge (+p4 which carries the green
# entrance arrow); only p12,p14,p15 a full bottom edge (+p8, red exit arrow); only
# p3,p4,p11,p12 a full left edge; only p2,p8,p9,p10 a full right edge. The four
# intersections force the corners p4/p2/p12/p8, leaving 384 candidate layouts.
# Exactly one of the 384 makes the 12x12 maze a perfect maze (144 cells, 143 open
# edges, fully connected => the green->red route is literally the ONLY path, matching
# the title). Independently, only 5 of the 384 never have the same boundary wall drawn
# by both neighbouring tiles, and the perfect-maze layout is one of those 5.
